extracted.name: No-bake donuts
extracted.description: This recipe is delicious! I have tried so many donut recipes but none of them helped or worked. I found this recipe somewhere and I was like “I have to try it before I give up”. I was amazed! And it being no bake but something you can fry is like cherry on top
instruction_lines: Mix 1 egg, 2 tbsp oil, 3/4 cup milk, 1 tbsp sugar, 3+ 1/4 baking powder, 1 tsp salt, and 2 +1/2 cup all- purpose flour (add one by one) together
Add a little bit of water (till it’s workable) in the dough
Flatten the dough and cut donuts out
Fry the donuts till they are golden brown
Prepare the glaze by mixing 1/2 cup powdered sugar and 2-3 tbsp milk
